# Dragoman's Journey

- [Dragoman's Journey · Josef Stephens](https://dragomansjourney.com/): AI, made easy. Josef Stephens builds AI tools for Sonoma County small businesses and nonprofits, and proves COBOL migrations work for banks.
- [The Local Route · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/local.html): Reels, apps and workflows for Sonoma County small businesses and nonprofits, made from what you already have and checked by a person before anything reaches your customers.
- [The Mainframe Route · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/mainframe.html): Moving off COBOL with AI? I build a tool that runs your old and new systems on the same real data, flags every difference, and gives your auditors proof they can check.
- [Packed-decimal decoder · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/comp3.html): Paste the bytes of a COMP-3 field and its picture clause. See every digit, the sign and the value, and what the number becomes under each reading of a rate.
- [Start a Blueprint · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/start.html): Start a two-week Blueprint: five minutes of questions, and Josef takes it from there. $1,500, fixed, credited in full toward your build.
- [Request a briefing · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/briefing.html): Request a briefing or a Survey quote for a COBOL migration. Tell me where it stands and I'll reply personally with what I'd look at first.
- [The Work · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/work.html): What Josef Stephens has built with AI: cooking reels that went from an evening of editing to about 4 minutes, a recipe app for teachers, Bird League, a detective game for birders, a public COBOL check, and free tools.
- [Case study: forty reels, one engine · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/case-reels.html): Every cooking class used to cost the program's creator an evening of editing. Now her phone clips go through an engine and come back as a finished reel in about four minutes.
- [Free 15-minute call · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/call.html): Grab a free 15-minute call with Josef Stephens about what AI could take off your plate. Tell him what you run and when you're free.
- [Reel Shot List · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/shotlist.html): A free planner for small businesses and nonprofits: pick what you run and get the 10 phone clips to film, in edit order and in one-lap shooting order.
- [Caption Fitter · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/captions.html): A free check for reel captions: balanced line breaks, no stranded words, clear of each app's buttons, enough time to read, and a see-through PNG to drop on your video.
- [Busywork Receipt · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/receipt.html): A free calculator for small businesses and nonprofits: ring up the chores that eat your week and see what they cost in a year, and which ones could honestly come back.
- [Recipe Scaler · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/scaler.html): A free recipe scaler for classrooms, kitchens and events: paste any ingredient list, set grown-ups and kids, and get amounts you can actually measure, plus when to split into batches.
- [Website Checkup · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/checkup.html): A free check for small businesses and nonprofits: paste your site's address and get a plain report of what's broken, and whether a machine can read your facts.
- [Voice checker · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/voicecheck.html): Paste words written with AI and see which sentences give it away, and what to put there instead.
- [The studio · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/studio.html): Everything I'm building right now, and the date each piece shipped. Apps, free tools and shirts, made with AI and a lot of real-phone testing. Get on a list and you hear first.
- [Bird League · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/studio-birdleague.html): Fantasy sports for birders. Draft real species, then score points against your league each week by finding them in the wild.
- [Deepcuts · Dragoman's Journey](https://dragomansjourney.com/studio-deepcuts.html): Indie games matched by how they actually play.
